parameter_estimation: Fixed R/X hypotheses; three operating factors and phase fitted once per particle from same 300 PMU reports
reference_correction: Particle-specific inverse-AC predicted PMU baseline and conditional operating point; common empirical frequency/ROCOF mean and noise fit
score: Unmodified R10 one-report prior-mixture predictive density; complete current births/OFF; no retrospective Bayes factor accumulated
posterior_status: Approximate prequential particle posterior, NOT calibrated or Bayes-optimal
forecast_note: forecast_whitened and forecast_innovation are postselection diagnostics using current-report theta posterior; prediction_last_report_used_s=t. Only theta_predictive_log_density is pre-update scoring.
physical_state_mixture_note: Each standardized state is a deviation from its own particle equilibrium; aggregate is diagnostic, not an absolute state estimate

recovery_proposal.initial_state: Causal H0 snapshot and V6 shared stationary covariance; integrated with innovations recursion
recovery_proposal.physical_and_process_uncertainty: Original V6 matrices and gains, unchanged
recovery_proposal.score: Bounded amplitude/fixed line opening, unexplained innovation variance profiled with floor1
